extract.ex_tt_stt: Transcribe speech into subtitles with WhisperX.
extract.ex_tt_mainlang: Text language in hardsubs. Changing here applies only to this session; “From Settings” uses the default from the Settings page.

Reuse this video's saved OCR results and rebuild subtitles with the current parameters.
Very fast — use it to fine-tune merge thresholds, similarity…

Run a trial OCR on a short mid-film segment with the current ROI and parameters.
Use it to check ROI/language before a full run.
extract.ex_tt_extract: Start scanning the whole video and OCR the subtitle region to extract text.
extract.ex_tt_batch:
Select multiple episodes at once. They SHARE the current ROI and parameters.
Episodes with a different resolution get their ROI auto-scaled.
extract.ex_tt_concat: Merge all ORIGINAL videos in a folder into one full-series file, then optionally load it to extract. Prefers stream copy (fast).
extract.ex_tt_roihint: 💡 Click a ROI below to select it as the extraction region. All ROIs are shown on the canvas.
extract.ex_tt_detect_hardsub: Auto-detect whether the video has hardsubs to suggest an OCR region.
extract.ex_tt_detect_roi: Auto-determine the subtitle region (ROI) by sampling frames.
extract.ex_tt_scan_embedded: List subtitle tracks available in the file (MKV/MP4…). Text tracks extract instantly; image tracks are OCR'd with PaddleOCR.
extract.ex_tt_sidecar: A sidecar subtitle file with the same name next to the video (auto-detected on open).
extract.ex_tt_load_sidecar: Load the selected sidecar subtitle into a line list (skips OCR).
extract.ex_tt_imglang: OCR model language for IMAGE subtitle tracks (VobSub/PGS). Automatic = inferred from the track language; choose manually if results have odd characters.
extract.ex_tt_stt_device: Automatic: use GPU if available, otherwise CPU. Choose CPU if you have the CPU build of torch.
extract.ex_tt_align: On: more accurate timestamps (needs wav2vec2/torchaudio). Off: sentence-level timestamps — more stable if FFmpeg DLLs are missing.
extract.ex_tt_model:
Accuracy: large-v3 ≈ large-v3-turbo > medium > small > base > tiny.
• large-v3-turbo (RECOMMENDED): ~6× faster than large-v3, near-equal quality, ~6GB VRAM, multilingual (CJK/Vietnamese).
• large-v3: maximum quality but slow & needs a strong GPU (~10GB VRAM).
• medium/small/tiny: for weaker machines.
If speech is missed, pick a larger model.
extract.ex_tt_aligndev: CPU: slower but avoids CUDA library conflicts (recommended). GPU: faster but some machines may hit access violations.
extract.ex_tt_diarize: Labels [SPEAKER_00], [SPEAKER_01]... for each speaker. Needs a (free) HuggingFace token and acceptance of the pyannote model terms.
extract.ex_tt_split: WhisperX groups speech into 20-30s blocks. Enable to split into short lines by punctuation / pauses / length — like standard subtitles.
extract.ex_tt_jieba: Uses rjieba to segment Chinese compounds so lines aren't cut mid-word (e.g. keeps '第一步' intact). Requires: pip install rjieba.
extract.ex_tt_install:
Creates an isolated 'whisperx_env' then installs torch (CUDA 12.9) + WhisperX.
Downloads about 3GB — the app's environment is left untouched.
extract.ex_chk_diarize: Speaker diarization — needs a HuggingFace token
extract.ex_chk_split: Auto-split long lines into short subtitles (recommended)
extract.ex_chk_jieba: Smart Chinese word segmentation (rjieba) — no mid-word cuts

settings.sec_spatial_filter: Spatial junk filter (remove misaligned / off-center text)

settings.tip_limit_side: Enter 0 to let PaddleOCR decide automatically (recommended).
settings.tip_auto_keep: CORE band cut threshold (× density peak). Higher = tighter band; lower = wider band.
settings.tip_auto_extend: Adjacent EXPANSION threshold (× peak). Lower to 0.25–0.35 for MULTI-LINE subtitles to keep the second line.
settings.tip_auto_botpad: LOWER-margin factor vs the top margin (prevents clipping descenders/diacritics).
settings.tip_auto_sensitivity: Heatmap threshold (×): LOWER for more sensitivity — catches short-lived info text (a few seconds); raise to filter more noise.
settings.tip_median_blend: Blurs the moving background and keeps only static text for maximum OCR accuracy.

settings.tip_ocr_model: PP-OCRv6 (medium) is the newest: a unified model for Chinese/Japanese/English + 46 Latin languages, more accurate and faster than v5. Requires PaddleOCR >= 3.7.
settings.tip_limit_hint: 💡 Tip: In Limit Side Len, enter 0 if you want the AI to auto-scale the image to the optimal ratio.
settings.tip_vidctx_height: Frame height when compressing video for the AI. Low (360p) = fewer tokens, fast, cheap; high = the AI 'sees' more clearly but costs more tokens. Recommended 360.
settings.tip_vidctx_fps: Frames per second when sending video to the AI. Gemini samples ~1 fps which is enough to understand the content. Higher = smoother but more tokens. Recommended 1.0.
settings.tip_vidctx_cq: GPU compression quality (NVENC). LOWER = sharper, larger file; HIGHER = blurrier, lighter. Recommended 32 (balanced).
settings.tip_vidctx_crf: CPU compression quality (libx264, used without a GPU). Similar to CQ. Recommended 30.
settings.tip_tokens_chunk: Token budget PER video segment (each segment is a separate AI call). Smaller = shorter segments, fewer timeouts, but more calls. If you often hit 'read operation timed out' on long videos, LOWER this value (e.g. 150000).
settings.tip_chunk_min: Maximum duration per segment (even if the token budget allows longer). Lower it for shorter segments to avoid timeouts.
settings.tip_tps: Estimated tokens per video second at low resolution (Gemini counts ~100 tokens/second). Only change this if you significantly raise the resolution/fps.
settings.tip_trans_batch: Subtitle lines sent to the AI per call. SMALL batches (e.g. 50) → the AI keeps the exact line count with fewer omissions/misnumbering (especially with light flash-lite models); LARGE batches → faster but more prone to missing lines that need patching. If logs often report 'missing line'/'line_no mismatch', LOWER this value.
settings.tip_trans_ctx: Context lines included on each side of a batch, for coherent translation and consistent forms of address. Recommended 10.
settings.tip_trans_retry: Retry count when the AI returns a transient error (429 overload, 503, timeout). Recommended 3.
settings.tip_trans_timeout: Maximum wait time per AI call. Raise it (e.g. 180-240s) if long context-video analysis segments hit 'read operation timed out'.
